Test_Description: Privilege Escalation via PUT /api/users/me - User promotes own role to admin
Audit_Rationale: Human extension: Critical vulnerability! PUT /api/users/me permits normal user to supply role="admin" and gain full admin rights!

Test_Description: Invalid Order State Transition Bug - Server allows transition from canceled to delivered (line 550 in server.js)
Audit_Rationale: Human extension: Defect in server.js line 550: `if (currentStatus === 'canceled' && status === 'delivered') isValidTransition = true;` allows canceled orders to be marked delivered!

Test_Description: Access Control Bypass via Case-Sensitivity (/API/ADMIN/USERS vs /api/admin/users)
Audit_Rationale: Human extension: Verifies case sensitivity in express route matching for admin access control.

Test_Description: Admin Session Invalidation on Password Reset / Role Revocation
Audit_Rationale: Human extension: SUT lacks token blacklist; revoked/demoted admin tokens remain valid until expiration.

Test_Description: Import Products CSV JSON Injection Attack (POST /api/admin/import-products)
Audit_Rationale: Human extension: Import products endpoint allows bulk insertion of negative price and unescaped XSS strings.
